scripts.dev: bun run dev:infra && bun run dev:apps
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose --profile host up -d caddy redis minio convex-backend convex-dashboard
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n api,web,worker "bun --cwd api dev" "bun --cwd web dev" "bun --cwd api worker:dev"
scripts.check: prettier --check . && eslint . --ext .js,.cjs,.mjs,.ts && bun run check:env && bun run --cwd packages/config typecheck && bun run --cwd api typecheck && bun run --cwd web typecheck
